title: Lantern and Letter
author: Tamsin Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Vane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
